core_obligations: The author derives precise permutation-cycle identities for the shuffle generators, develops two index-sensitive annihilator chains, and uses them to show mixed products of commutators vanish at the stated linear thresholds. The right-tail and final-index estimates are one quantitative annihilation family, with power-nilpotence as a consequence. This is stronger index-specific product information than the generic filtration/spectrum statements for linear combinations.
